text:
zoe: Quick thread Edge Inference Show & Tell — community-first event + tiny refapp release. Need owners for launch post, one-page benchmark blurb, landing page, webinar ops, and inbound routing. Who's in?

marc: I'll own the launch post and the short how-to. Plan: ~500 words, code-first, with 3 inline snippets and a TL;DR callout.

hannah: I can run a compact benchmark sweep (2 models, 256/512 tokens) and produce a hero stat + reproducible CSV + 3-line script. Will mark results as "representative" not prescriptive.

leo: I'll do the LP variants and short GIFs. Two LP angles: (A) "Build for edge latency" code-first hero, (B) "Cost-aware inference" benchmark hero. Can deliver mocks by tomorrow.

anya: Webinar ops and routing: propose a 35m session (15m demo, 15m QA, 5m next-steps). Routing: trial users, OSS contributors, and partners. Partners get a private early-access CTA.

zoe: Nice. Quick asks: 1) Benchmark hero must be conservative wording: "up to ~30% lower unit cost on our sample workload" and include p99 for latency. 2) Email segmentation: add triggers for "trial tokens > 8k" and "repo stars > 3". 3) Include a tiny maintainer checklist for partners.

marc: Will draft the post structure: intro, quickstart (3 steps), optimization notes (batching/cache), links to bench and repo. Will include a 2-line YAML config for Private deploy.

hannah: Infra ask: 100 GPU minutes for the sweep. Approve?

zoe: Approved 100 GPU minutes, log under GH issue edge-show-and-tell-bench.

leo: Design note: hero A wants an animated terminal GIF showing <50ms responses. Hero B will include a small stat strip: median + p99 + cost/token. I'll A/B the CTAs: "Run on your machine" vs "See benchmark details".

anya: Drip plan: T0 announce, T+2 days deep-dive post + webinar invite, T+7 webinar reminder + tutorial, T+14 replay + maintainers invite. Partners get T0 private access. Add UTM tags.

marc: Short CTA options: A) "Clone the Edge Refapp and run in 5 min" B) "Try low-latency inference now". Leaning to A for dev-first.

hannah: I'll attach raw CSV and a small Python script so users can repro. Hero stat (tentative): "~28% lower unit cost with batching+cache; p99 within interactive SLOs". Will tighten after runs.

zoe: Keep public language conservative and link to reproducibles. Also add a tiny note about sample sizes and model variants.

anya: Ops note: cap webinar at 400, enable captions, record. Use a CRM webhook to tag registrants by segment. If registrant has >5 repo contributions, auto-send maintainer invite email.

leo: Will prepare LP mocks and GIFs. Need copy snippets from Marc for hero and subhead.

marc: Draft ETA: PR in 48h. Will include code snippets and README checklist.

hannah: Running a quick smoke today; full sweep tomorrow morning. Will post interim numbers.

ops-bot: Reminder: create GH issue "edge-show-and-tell-playbook" and assign owners in 6 hours.

zoe: Owners recap: Marc = post & repo copy, Hannah = benchmark + reproducibles, Leo = LP & GIFs, Anya = webinar ops & routing. Post blockers by EOD or on the GH issue. :rocket:
